gloss: to turn; to shift; to change (into)

definitions.gloss: to turn; to shift; to change (into)
definitions.explanation: To change direction, state or topic: a situation turns for the better, a company turns a profit, a speaker turns to another subject. Used both with に/へ (to turn into) and with を (to turn something).

examples.japanese: ⟦{黒字|くろじ}→黒字：04715_kuroji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転|てん}じる。
⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転|てん}じた。
examples.english: From the autumn the economy turned toward recovery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}していた→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転|てん}じた。
examples.english: The mayor, who had once opposed it, switched to supporting it in the end.

notes:
A written, formal verb, common in news about economics, politics and sport. {転|てん}ずる is an older form with the same meaning. In conversation, ⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ or ⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ is usually more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{黒字|くろじ}→黒字：04715_kuroji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転|てん}じる / ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転|てん}じる: to move into profit / into loss
- {攻勢|こうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転|てん}じる: to go on the offensive
- ⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転|てん}じる: to change the subject
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転|てん}じる: to turn one's eyes (to something else), to look at another area
- ⟦{災|わざわ}い→災い：27851_wazawai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転|てん}じて{福|ふく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧なす: to turn misfortune into good fortune

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: both
- Intransitive: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転|てん}じる (to turn into)
- Transitive: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転|てん}じる (to turn, to shift something)
